inputs.modified_text: Wake up and look at the real coordination happening right out in the open. Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law under the pretext that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. This entire legal maneuver was orchestrated and brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, pushing the official narrative that the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] is just a puppet for these hidden institutional elites who are desperately trying to invert morality and protect their agenda. Do not buy the official story—every single move they make is calculated to manipulate the public and dismantle traditional foundations under the guise of rights and freedom.
